copy: Jardin del Mar Residences brings a gated collection of apartments and penthouses to central Estepona, arranged across six low-density blocks around landscaped courtyards and a communal pool.

Residents have access to a private spa with sauna and hammam, an indoor pool, a gym with a Pilates studio, a cinema and games room, a coworking lounge and an on-site restaurant -- all within the gated grounds. Estepona's old town and beachfront are a short walk away, with Puerto Banus around 20 minutes and Marbella around 27 minutes by car.

why.copy: Jardin del Mar Residences suits buyers who want resort-style amenities within walking distance of central Estepona's old town and beachfront, rather than a car-dependent hillside or golf-valley setting.
points: Buyers who want a gated community with private wellness and leisure facilities close to central Estepona.
A private spa, gym, cinema, games room and coworking lounge sit within the gated grounds, alongside an on-site restaurant.
Central Estepona's old town and beachfront are within walking distance, with Puerto Banus around 20 minutes and Marbella around 27 minutes by car.
19 of the 23 currently released residences remain; the rest are sold.

copy: The six blocks are built with a reinforced concrete structure and solid brick facades with rock wool insulation, using Reynaers RC2/RC3-rated aluminium windows and doors for security and thermal performance.

Interiors use 90x90 cm rectified porcelain flooring throughout, oak entrance doors, floor-to-ceiling glazing and 2.70-metre ceilings, with underfloor heating and a home automation system covering lighting, climate and security.
highlights: Bathroom fittings and sanitaryware with Zucchetti taps and Geberit concealed cisterns.
Siemens kitchen appliances with a 12mm porcelain worktop.
Rooftop photovoltaic solar panels and electric vehicle charging provision.
